text: I successfully created the Next.js app, installed CopilotKit packages, configured the runtime endpoint, and started the dev server. The copilot endpoint demonstrably works: a `GET` to `/api/copilotkit/info` returned HTTP 200 with JSON confirming the `BuiltInAgent` was registered (`{"version":"1.70.3","agents":{"default":{"name":"default","className":"BuiltInAgent"...}}`). However, the production build was killed by the OOM killer (exit 137) after hanging for minutes, and the root frontend route `/` returned empty content, suggesting the page compilation stalled or failed. I also had to deviate from the docs by using a placeholder `OPENAI_API_KEY` since no real key was present in the sandbox environment.
